title.zh: 预沉积再分布：两阶段解决两个问题
title.en: Predeposition and drive-in: two stages solve two problems

subtitle.zh: 掺杂量导入/表面峰值 / 曲线展宽 / 结深移动
subtitle.en: Dose introduction / surface peak / profile broadening / junction movement

body.zh: 预沉积主要建立掺杂量，再分布主要把已有掺杂重新塑形。
body.en: Predeposition mainly establishes dopant dose; drive-in mainly reshapes existing dopants.

body.zh: 两阶段对比：同一片晶圆的掺杂剖面演化
body.en: Two-stage comparison: dopant-profile evolution in the same wafer

body.zh: 预沉积建立掺杂量，再分布使剖面更深更宽、表面峰值降低
body.en: Predeposition establishes dose; drive-in broadens and deepens the profile while lowering the surface peak

body.zh: 在更高温度下驱动扩散
body.en: Drive diffusion at a higher temperature

body.zh: 在较低温度下引入掺杂
body.en: Introduce dopants at a lower temperature

body.zh: 从清洁到剖面验证的完整流程
body.en: Complete sequence from cleaning to profile verification

body.zh: 这些参数决定掺杂量与剖面的最终形貌
body.en: These parameters determine final dose and profile shape

body.zh: 掺杂量、表面状态和剖面形貌异常都会影响器件性能
body.en: Abnormal dose, surface conditions and profiles affect device performance

body.zh: 再分布可加深并展宽剖面，但也带来新的影响
body.en: Drive-in deepens and broadens the profile but brings new effects

body.zh: 多种量测手段相互印证，快速判断是否达标
body.en: Cross-check several measurements to rapidly assess compliance
of whether dopant dose meets the target

body.zh: 不是所有流程都明确拆成两个独立步骤，
body.en: Not all flows explicitly separate these two steps.

body.zh: 具体工艺可能将两步合并或采用其他方式实现相同目标。
body.en: A specific process may combine them or use other methods to achieve the same objective.
